page.overview:
Who is Felipe Drugovich?

Felipe Drugovich Roncato (born 23 May 2000, in Maringá, Paraná, Brazil) is a Brazilian-Italian racing driver of Austrian descent who competed in FIA Formula 2 Championship with MP Motorsport where he won 1st place and was crowned as the 2022 Formula 2 champion.

Two days following obtaining his F2 title, announced Drugovich would be the first member of their Driver Development Programme; the team's newly formed junior driver academy. As part of his role in the Aston Martin Driver Developement Programme, Drugovich takes on the role of reserve driver for the team; he took Lance Stroll's place during FP1 at the 2022 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix held at the Yas Marina Circuit.
